text:
Alex: Ok who keeps summoning the fridge goblin? Lunches disappearing again. :face_with_monocle:
Maria: Not me. I swear the Tupperware union voted early. :woman-shrugging:
Devon: I saw a suspicious trail of marinara leading to the conference room. :eyes:
Sam: my bolognese is missing. Putting GPS on next lunch. :gps: :laughing:
Jordan: Suggestion: label everything with stickers. "DO NOT EAT — JORDAN'S SCIENCE EXPERIMENT" :stuck_out_tongue:
Maria: also vote: quick two-word badge for fridge owners? react :one: for "Lunch Keeper" or :two: for "Thermo Thief"
Alex: :one: Lunch Keeper
Devon: :two:
Sam: :one: (also pls stop stealing my bolognese)
Lina: I leave decoy salad with glitter next time. :sparkles:
Alex: Can we make a 30-second ritual: put name + date + emoji on sticker? I'll print a sheet.
Sam: Alex you're a hero. :heart:
Maria: Also shoutout to Janet for cleaning the shelf last week. :clap:
Janet: I accept the nomination for Chief Fridge Janitor. :broom:
Devon: Whoever wins gets a tiny trophy (desk gnome) and immunity from fridge shaming for a month. :trophy:
Alex: ok poll: react with :one: for stickers tonight, :two: for fridge cam (lol), :three: for decoy glitter salad
Lina: voted :three:
Jordan: :one:
Sam: :one:
Maria: :two: (jk, :one:)
poll-bot: poll created by Alex — poll open for 24h (reacted :spiral_calendar:)
Alex: result so far: stickers + desk gnome policy, Janet officially janitor. case closed. :sunglasses:
Maria: bring the gnome to onboarding orientation. tradition starts now. :seedling:
